statusHistory.note: New pin, operator-commissioned as a smoke test of the publishing pipeline (2026-09-15, same day as the public/private repo split). Fills two standing gaps at once: BACKLOG's outstanding 'North London — Dalston or Stoke Newington' ask, and near-events' mandatory dated-event check (Kyoko Takenaka book launch, 2026-09-23, filed as a child page). Research floor: near-deep-researcher pass across Time Out, London the Inside, The Infatuation, EastLondonLines, and the venue's own site; Reddit search returned no relevant threads (leg 2 of the UGC floor came up empty on this subject, not blocked — documented per the fallback-ladder honesty rule); Google Maps reviews checked directly via claude-in-chrome (leg 3) — 5.0/17, all positive, venue too new for a review pattern either way. Hero is a Time Out editorial photo of the actual Dalston venue from its opening coverage, attributed and linked. No operator-location-privacy conflict (this is London, not Baixada Santista).
